h1: An animation studio for Dubai brands, with video and AI video under the same lead
intro: We make 2D and 3D animation, motion graphics, explainers, reels and AI video for established Dubai companies: launch films for property, product animation for retail and FMCG, explainers for fintech in the DIFC and short-form content for hospitality. Everything is planned for English and Arabic audiences and delivered in the formats each platform needs.

sections.h: Why animation suits so much Dubai work
p: A lot of what Dubai companies need to show does not exist yet, or cannot be filmed easily. A tower that is still a plot of sand. A payment app's security model. A logistics network linking Jebel Ali to a dozen countries. A treatment that clinic advertising rules make awkward to show on camera. Animation handles all of these, and it travels well across languages because the visuals carry most of the message.

It also suits remote production. An animation studio does not need to be in the same room as the client, only in the same conversation, which is why our Dubai clients get the same process as our London ones.

list: 2D animation and animated explainers for products, services and processes.

Motion graphics for launches, events, social media and screens in sales galleries and lobbies.

Brand films and corporate video, using your footage or a planned shoot.

sections.h: English, Arabic and one master edit
p: Most Dubai videos need at least two language versions, sometimes more for Russian, Hindi or Chinese-speaking buyers. We plan for that from the storyboard: text kept off the base animation where possible, layouts that work left to right and right to left, and timing that leaves room for longer translations.

Arabic scripts and voiceover come from you or from translators and voice artists you approve. We do not claim in-house Arabic copywriters. What we do is build the edit so every language version comes from one master, which keeps changes quick and the brand consistent.

We run a managed video editing team for a US client, producing content on a fixed weekly schedule. That rhythm, a brief on Monday and a delivery on the date promised, is how we run ongoing social content for brands that publish often.

list: Talk: the goal, the audience, where the video will run and what it must make people do.
Plan: script, storyboard, style frames, language versions and delivery dates, signed off in writing.
Build: animation or edit, with review rounds at agreed stages rather than a single reveal at the end.
Grow: cut-downs, formats for each platform, and new versions based on what performs.

sections.h: Working with our animation studio: Dubai to London
p: We serve Dubai businesses from London, on-site when the project needs it. Animation and editing run entirely online, with review links you can comment on frame by frame, and Gulf Standard Time sits four hours ahead of London in winter, three in summer, so feedback sent in your afternoon is usually picked up the same day.
Live-action shoots are different. When a project needs filming in Dubai, we say so at scoping and agree with you how it will be crewed, so there are no surprises later.

sections.h: Choosing an animation studio? Dubai buyers should check these
p: Showreels all look good, because every studio picks its best work. These questions tell you far more about how your own project will actually go, and who will be accountable when a deadline gets tight.
list: Can they show work in your sector, not just their favourite style?
Do they plan language versions at storyboard stage, or translate at the end?
How many review rounds are included, and at which stages?
Who owns the project files, models and music licences afterwards?
Can the same team cut the film into ads, reels and website loops, or will you need another supplier?
Length, style and whether it is 2D, 3D or a mix.
How much has to be modelled or illustrated from scratch.
Number of language versions and formats.
Voiceover, music licensing and any live-action footage.
Whether it is a single film or a monthly content programme.

sections.h: Why 22 Signals over a standalone animation studio
p: A standalone animation studio, Dubai-based or not, can make a beautiful film. We make the film and then put it to work: in paid campaigns, on the website, in the app store listing and in the 3D renders that sit alongside it. One lead, one plan, one brief. Related services include 3D rendering, AI video production and paid media.

faqs.q: Are you an animation studio in Dubai?
faqs.a: We are a London company working as the animation studio Dubai brands brief remotely, with meeting hours overlapping Gulf Standard Time. We do not have premises in Dubai. For animation that makes little difference, since scripts, storyboards and reviews all happen online, and we visit when a project genuinely needs it.

faqs.q: Do you make both 2D and 3D animation?
faqs.a: Yes. 2D suits explainers, data and processes. 3D suits products, buildings and anything that needs depth, materials or a camera moving around it. Many Dubai projects mix both, for example a 3D tower with 2D motion graphics for the payment plan. We recommend a style once we understand the message and audience.

Yes. We build every project so English and Arabic versions come from one master edit, with right-to-left layouts for on-screen text. Arabic scripts and voiceover come from you or translators and voice artists you approve, and we make sure timing, typography and subtitles work correctly.

faqs.q: What is AI video, and is it right for us?
faqs.a: AI video uses generative tools for presenters, scenes or ad variations. It suits fast testing of ad concepts and content where filming is impractical. It is not right for everything, especially regulated health or finance claims. Anything we make with AI is labelled clearly and checked by a person before it goes out.

faqs.q: How long does an animated explainer take?
faqs.a: A short explainer usually takes a few weeks from script to final delivery, depending on style, length, language versions and how quickly approvals come back. 3D work and longer films take longer. The schedule, with dates for each review stage, is agreed in writing at the start.

When a project needs live-action footage in Dubai, we raise it at scoping and agree with you how the shoot will be crewed and when we will attend. For many projects we work with footage you already have, or replace the shoot with animation, 3D or AI video instead.
